info.title: Sprout authenticated function API
info.description: Execute sprout-api through the Appwrite Functions SDK with a user session. Appwrite supplies the user JWT at execution time. Every request binds x-sprout-account to the expected account; every POST also includes the matching _account field. These are race guards, not authorization. Owner is derived from the verified JWT. Financial POSTs remain disabled until SPROUT_FINANCIAL_WRITES is enabled after staged consistency proof. Money is signed integer USD cents. This document covers request surfaces; response schemas are still being completed.
